description: Null for a variadic dynamic pseudo-type parameter accepting null only gives the dynamic value
notes: The null keyword is a value of the dynamic pseudo-type, which this variadic parameter doesn't accept, but the spec only states a consequence for the dynamic value, an unknown; the parameter accepts null, so the function should return a tuple holding null. The spec also guarantees that no expression is unknown unless a variable or function result is. go-cty tests the argument's type instead of whether it is unknown, so the null makes it return the dynamic value without calling the function (Function.returnTypeForValues in cty/function/function.go). For a parameter of any other type, hashicorp/hcl first converts the null keyword to a null of that type (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so this only happens for parameters of the dynamic pseudo-type.
